svg.title: First Fire Cinder Court measured Gate 1 floor plan
svg.desc: A measured 58 by 44 metre floor plan, vertical section, sequence evidence, and five-state storyboard for the reimagined First Fire room.

text.tspan: GATE 1 MEASURED CONTRACT · isolated review shell · 1 m units
1 · FLOOR PLAN · ONE S FROM WATER → DJ → EK → FL → EARTH
separate in and out mouth per court
basalt owns collision, fire never does
DJ hidden until you turn in: PASS
EK hidden until you turn in: PASS
FL hidden until you turn in: PASS
3 · VERTICAL SECTION · LANE INTO ONE ROCK-ISOLATED COURT
The beacon reads from the lane. The performer does not. The court opens only once the player turns into the mouth.
Visible runtime path diagnostics: Gate 0 capture pending
Gate 1 proves measured intent. The next Blender pass must preserve this single-S topology and may not mutate the live cave shell.
